ExtraDock 4.2.5 – Align, Space & Shine! 🌟✨

✨ What's New

  • Full-Width Dock Alignment: Move apps to the left, center, or right when the dock is in full width mode — total control over your dock layout!
  • Edge Padding: Add edge padding for fixed docks — fine-tune the space between your dock and the screen edge!

🌠 Effects

  • New Rays Effect: A stunning new Rays effect to make your dock truly stand out!

🎨 Customization

  • Item Spacing Presets: Choose between Default, Roomy, or Spacious spacing presets — pick the layout density that suits your style!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Performance Boost: Improved CPU and Memory usage when using Effects — smoother and lighter than ever!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
